login-1440.descripcion: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
login-1440.resumenPrimerNodo:
Fix any of the following:
  Target has insufficient size (16px by 16px, should be at least 24px by 24px)
  Target has insufficient space to its closest neighbors. Safe clickable space has a diameter of 16px instead of at least 24px.
